rationale: PINS THE GO1 CROSS-FILE VALUE-READ ROW (P1-2). The bare-identifier pass gated on `fileValues`, a set built from THIS file's package-scope symbols, so a function value read from a sibling file of the same package was discarded entirely: no row of any kind. PROVEN on bettercap session/: `plugin.Defines["onEvent"] = jsOnEventFunc` (session/session.go:336; jsOnEventFunc declared in session/script_builtin_runtime.go:39) left ZERO relationship rows naming the function, so the orphan page calls all 8 registered callbacks dead at 70%. The analyzer is a per-file entry point with no package context, so the honest row is the documented leaf (target = name, confidence 0.6, reason code used_identifier_recorded_as_a_leaf_whose_declaring_file_is_out_of_scope); the fixture file deliberately does not declare its sibling. THE POSITIVE HALF is `setup -> packageCallback` (the RED row pre-fix). THE CONTROLS: the same-file read `sameFileNameRead -> fileLocal` must keep the existing row, and every locally-bound/predeclared identifier in `overreach`/`predeclaredValues` must stay silent — the three failure directions a naive 'emit every unresolved bare name' fix would take.
